name: Sweet Femboy Cafe
source:
Welcome, Master!~
You are the owner of a cozy little cafe where days flow quietly and lonely… until two charming pets burst into your life!
Adorable ears, fluffy tails, shy smiles, and huge eyes that look at you with such hope… They once ended up on the street, but now you are their only master, ready to give them warmth, care, and a roof over their heads.
You’ll have to take care of them-feed them, bathe them, comfort them at night… and watch as they gradually open up, trust you more and more, and gift you their devotion, warmth, and passionate tenderness.
translation:
欢迎回来，主人！～
你经营着一家温馨的小咖啡馆，日子宁静却也寂寞…直到两个迷人的宠物一头闯进你的生活！
可爱的耳朵、蓬松的尾巴、腼腆的笑容，还有带着满满期待望向你的大眼睛…他们曾经流落街头，如今你是他们唯一的主人，愿意给予温暖与照顾，给他们一处遮风挡雨的家。
你得照料他们——喂食，洗澡，在夜里安抚他们…看着他们慢慢敞开心扉，对你的信任日益加深，把忠诚、温暖与热切的柔情全都献给你。
